**Coaching Note:**

Your knight on e5 was perfectly placed to launch a mating attack! The move Nf3+ gives check and forces the king out, then Nh4+ keeps checking from another angle. Each move narrows White's escape squares. Notice how a check forces your opponent to react—you control the tempo.
